snippet.title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Release Date trailer for Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy is here.
This new glimpse pulls you deeper into the Cristo Morente convent, a place shaped by silence, shifting spaces, and the weight of what was never meant to be uncovered.

Inside the villa, every step feels unstable. Every room carries echoes that refuse to fade. And the presence stalking the halls grows more deliberate the further you go. Survival demands patience, awareness, and the courage to face what the villa has kept hidden.

Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy marks the return of the saga, built on atmosphere, tension, and the kind of psychological horror that defined Remothered from the beginning.

The date is set. Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy launches October 27, 2026.
The doors are ready to open.

Wishlist now. Escape later.
